---

## 🔫 Dependency Injection: A Gangster's Guide to C#

### The Problem: Doing Everything Yourself is a Rookie Move

Imagine you're a street boss (a C# class), and every time you need a getaway driver, you go out, *build a car yourself* from scratch. That's called **tight coupling**, and it's the rookie mistake.

content.text: Your `OrderService` class straight-up creates its own `PaymentGateway` using `new` right inside. Creating dependencies using `new` inside a class causes several issues — you're locked in, fam.

That's snitching on yourself. Bad look.

### The Gangster Move: Let Someone ELSE Bring You What You Need

content.text: Dependency Injection is a design pattern where an object's dependencies are **supplied by an external source** rather than the object creating them itself.
Think of it like this:

content.text: If the Chef goes daily to the farm to get vegetables, that's tight coupling (Chef depends directly on Farm). Instead, the Restaurant Owner delivers vegetables to the Chef — *that's* Dependency Injection. Now the Chef only focuses on cooking, not sourcing vegetables.

content.text:
- `AddTransient` → Creates a **new instance every time** it's requested
- `AddScoped` → **One instance per request**
- `AddSingleton` → **One instance for the entire app's lifetime**

---

### Why Go Gangster with DI?

| Without DI 😤 | With DI 😎 |
|---|---|
| Hard-coded, rigid | Flexible & swappable |
| Hard to test | Easy to mock & test |
| Tightly coupled | Loosely coupled |
| Modify everything to change one thing | Change one registration, done |

citations.cited_text: Improved Testability: Dependencies can be readily mocked or stubbed, making unit testing more simple and effective. Enhanced Flexibility: Enables the ...
citations.title: What is Dependency Injection in C# With Example (Guide)

content.text: Dependencies can be readily **mocked or stubbed**, making unit testing simpler. It enables the injection of multiple implementations at runtime. And it **reduces tight coupling** between classes, making the software more modular and maintainable.

---

### The Bottom Line 🎯

citations.cited_text: Dependency Injection reduces the hard-coded dependencies among your classes by injecting those dependencies at run time instead of design time technic...
citations.title: Dependency Injection in C# (2023)

content.text: Dependency Injection **reduces hard-coded dependencies** among your classes by injecting those dependencies at run time instead of design time.

You're the Don. You don't build your own cars, grow your own food, or create your own tools. You **call the shots**, and your consigliere (the DI container) makes sure the right people show up with the right equipment, right when you need them. 🤌

Stay loosely coupled out there. 🧢
